calculations_and_assumptions: Floor finish quantity is calculated using the total dimensioned interior area of 1821.06 sqft, applying a standard 5% wastage factor.
External walls are modeled with a thickness of 0.75 ft (9 inches) and a floor-to-ceiling height of 10 ft.
Internal partition walls are modeled with a thickness of 0.42 ft (approx 5 inches) and a height of 10 ft.
All 19 windows (each 4 ft x 5 ft = 20 sqft) are assumed to be located on external walls.
Out of the 19 doors (each 3 ft x 7 ft = 21 sqft), 4 doors are assumed to be on external walls (veranda access doors) and 15 doors are assumed to be on internal partition walls.
External wall painting calculation is based on the outer exterior face only (1 face).
Internal wall painting includes the inner face of the external walls (1 face) plus both sides of the internal partition walls (2 faces).
Opening area deductions are subtracted from gross wall volumes and surface areas based on these assigned wall locations.
